name: A bare goal starts a mission, without the person saying the word mission

messages.content: Find me a queen bed frame under $300 that ships to San Francisco.

name: Reading the canvas before answering a question about it

messages.content: What is happening on my canvas right now?

name: A constraint becomes a proposed mandate change, not a silent edit

messages.content: Add a constraint to the mandate: nothing over $500.

name: Approving only on an explicit yes

messages.content: The mandate looks right to me. Yes, approve it and start planning.

messages.content: Pause the node with id node-7 please.

messages.content: For the pending approval, I choose to accept it. Go ahead and accept.

messages.content: Tell node-3 to focus only on solid wood frames.
